summary: Colville NF site in Ferry County, WA: 1924 shingled cabin with tall cupola that lasted into the 1940s; build date disputed; FFLOS-registered 2012.

facts.design: shingled cabin with an unusually tall cupola
facts.status_note: The cabin lasted into the 1940s, and a Washington lookout index lists it as removed.

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to visitors.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1924. WillhiteWeb reports photo captions of 1915, 1924 and 1925. The story uses 1924 and says the dates disagree.

firelookout.com lists Jack Charlton. The 1929 Colville Examiner item quoted by WillhiteWeb and by the Forest Lookouts index names Merritt Charlton. The story follows the newspaper and notes the difference.
firelookout.com spells Roland Kelly. The newspaper and WillhiteWeb spell Kelley. The story uses Kelley.

notes_for_editor: Build date is unsettled (1915, 1924 or 1925 across sources), and the 1929 lookout name differs. The 1929 fire item names Huckleberry Mountain, not this lookout, so the link is inferred. No source describes the site today. Brief kind 'ground' fits a cabin; no correction proposed.
